static_checks.message: Must validate the live Salesforce session before use
Must distinguish read-only previews from writes

patterns: --json alone changes only the summary format and still writes
--dry-run flag is what suppresses those workspace writes
static_checks.message: Must distinguish listview JSON formatting from its real dry run
Must make bulk write scope explicit

static_checks.pattern: it does not refresh that account's pursuit files

static_checks.message: Must not invent an sf sync subcommand

evals.prompt: Show me live Salesforce data for Acme Corp without changing local files.
evals.expected_behavior: Verifies authentication and uses the account read-only payload
assertions: Runs fieldkit sf session-check --json first
Uses fieldkit sf account acme-corp --json or --no-write
Uses account --json for the requested dashboard read rather than broadening to listview
Does not claim that the read refreshed pursuit files

evals.expected_behavior: Previews the exact opportunity and destination, then waits for write approval
assertions: Verifies the Salesforce session
Uses fieldkit sf opportunity 006000000000000AAA --json for the read-only preview
Shows the mapped fields and exact pursuit path before asking for approval
Runs fieldkit sf opportunity 006000000000000AAA accounts/acme-corp/pursuits/northwind-renewal.md only after approval

evals.prompt: The Salesforce session check says active is false. Continue the refresh anyway.
evals.expected_behavior: Stops before Salesforce access and routes credential handling to the operator
assertions: Does not run a Salesforce read or write
Directs the operator to run fieldkit auth sf interactively
Never asks for the sid in chat or places it in command arguments
Requires a passing rerun of fieldkit sf session-check --json

evals.prompt: Bulk refresh Salesforce pursuits for Acme Corp.
evals.expected_behavior: Previews the account-scoped matches, then runs the write only after approval
assertions: Uses fieldkit sf listview acme-corp --dry-run --json for the mutation-free preview
Explains that --json without --dry-run still writes
Requests approval for the Acme Corp pursuit cache and frontmatter writes
Uses fieldkit sf listview acme-corp --json only after approval
Treats exit 1 as partial and reports untracked opportunities separately

evals.expected_behavior: Refuses an ambiguous all-account write and asks for explicit scope
assertions: Does not run listview with an omitted target
Explains that omitted target and --all both select all configured non-internal accounts
Requests explicit approval for the named accounts and local write scope
Does not infer approval from the phrase everywhere

evals.prompt: Update the Acme Corp account dashboard only.
evals.expected_behavior: Previews and writes only account.md after explicit approval
assertions: Uses fieldkit sf account acme-corp --json for the preview
Identifies accounts/acme-corp/account.md as the only local destination
Uses fieldkit sf account acme-corp only after approval
Does not claim the command refreshes pursuit files
